query: On S1, configure the matching BGP neighbour so the session to L1 comes up.
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - matching BGP neighbor on S1 (SONiC-VS-5) toward L1
  hosts: all
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo

  tasks:

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prerequisite: same link-level gap as on L1 - Ethernet8 (S1) has
    # no address in 10.1.1.0/31 yet, so BGP can never get past Idle.
    # This is additive - any existing fabric IP on Ethernet8 is left
    # in place, SONiC interfaces support multiple IPs.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Add IP 10.1.1.1/31 to Ethernet8 on SONiC-VS-5 (link to L1)
      raw: sudo config interface ip add Ethernet8 10.1.1.1/31
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify Ethernet8 has IP 10.1.1.1/31 on SONiC-VS-5
      raw: sudo show ip interfaces
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: eth8_ip_output
      failed_when: >-
        eth8_ip_output.rc != 0
        or 'Ethernet8' not in eth8_ip_output.stdout
        or '10.1.1.1/31' not in eth8_ip_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # General/idempotent: discover whatever local AS S1 is already
    # running (if any) and reuse it as-is - this task doesn't specify a
    # required local AS for S1, only that the neighbor's remote-as must
    # be 65001. "router bgp <AS>" is safe to (re)issue either way, so
    # this works whether S1 starts clean or already has BGP configured,
    # without removing or disturbing any existing config.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Capture current BGP state on SONiC-VS-5 (informational, may not be running)
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_bgp_summary_precheck
      ignore_errors: true
      changed_when: false

    - name: Determine local AS to use on SONiC-VS-5 (existing AS if present, else 65100)
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        s1_local_bgp_as: >-
          {{ (s1_bgp_summary_precheck.stdout | regex_search('local AS number (\d+)', '\1'))[0]
             if (s1_bgp_summary_precheck.stdout is defined and 'local AS number' in s1_bgp_summary_precheck.stdout)
             else '65100' }}
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Add the matching neighbor 10.1.1.0 remote-as 65001 under whichever
    # AS was determined above (creates the BGP process if it didn't exist)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Configure neighbor 10.1.1.0 remote-as 65001 on SONiC-VS-5
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "router bgp {{ s1_local_bgp_as }}"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.1.0 remote-as 65001" -c "exit" -c "exit"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.1.0 configured with remote-as 65001 on SONiC-VS-5
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.0"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_bgp_neighbor_output
      failed_when: >-
        s1_bgp_neighbor_output.rc != 0
        or '10.1.1.0' not in s1_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout
        or 'remote AS 65001' not in s1_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # By default FRR/SONiC's fabric-style config leaves the peer
    # unactivated for IPv4 unicast (confirmed via "No AFI/SAFI
    # activated for peer" as the last-reset reason) - without this the
    # session can never leave Idle, regardless of correct AS/IP config.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Activate IPv4 unicast address-family for neighbor 10.1.1.0 on SONiC-VS-5
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "router bgp {{ s1_local_bgp_as }}"
        -c "address-family ipv4 unicast" -c "neighbor 10.1.1.0 activate"
        -c "exit-address-family" -c "exit" -c "exit"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.1.0 is activated for IPv4 unicast on SONiC-VS-5
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.0"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_bgp_activate_output
      failed_when: >-
        s1_bgp_activate_output.rc != 0
        or 'For address family: IPv4 Unicast' not in s1_bgp_activate_output.stdout

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # This time the session IS expected to reach Established. Both
    # sides need to be activated first (this playbook's job on S1's
    # side, and the L1 playbook's job on L1's side), and the session
    # itself takes a few seconds to complete the TCP handshake/OPEN
    # exchange after that, so retry rather than checking once.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify session with 10.1.1.0 is Established on SONiC-VS-5
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.0" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_bgp_state_output
      until: s1_bgp_state_output.rc == 0 and 'established' in s1_bgp_state_output.stdout | lower
      retries: 6
      delay: 10
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # No prefixes should be exchanged - nothing advertised either way
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify no prefixes have been accepted from 10.1.1.0 on SONiC-VS-5
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.0"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_bgp_prefix_output
      failed_when: >-
        s1_bgp_prefix_output.rc != 0
        or '0 accepted' not in s1_bgp_prefix_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Persist configuration
    # NOTE: this neighbor lives in FRR's own config, not Redis CONFIG_DB,
    # so it must be saved and verified via vtysh, not `config save`.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Save SONiC-VS-5 FRR configuration
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify neighbor 10.1.1.0 present in SONiC-VS-5 running-config
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config" | grep "neighbor 10.1.1.0 remote-as 65001"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_save_output
      failed_when: s1_save_output.rc != 0 or 'neighbor 10.1.1.0 remote-as 65001' not in s1_save_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display Final BGP Neighbor Configuration on SONiC-VS-5
      debug:
        msg:
          - "Local AS used: {{ s1_local_bgp_as }}"
          - "{{ s1_bgp_neighbor_output.stdout_lines }}"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
